monthly AS (
  SELECT UserId,
         strftime('%Y-%m', CreationDate) AS month,
         AVG(Score) AS month_avg
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY UserId, month
),
rolling AS (

         month,
         AVG(month_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY UserId ORDER BY month

  FROM monthly
)

FROM rolling
ORDER BY UserId, month;

WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
    WHERE DATE(u.CreationDate) = DATE(b.Date)
),
user_views AS (
    SELECT qu.UserId, COALESCE(SUM(p.ViewCount), 0) AS TotalViews
    FROM qualified_users qu
    LEFT JOIN posts p ON qu.UserId = p.OwnerUserId
    GROUP BY qu.UserId
),
total_views AS (
    SELECT SUM(TotalViews) AS GrandTotal FROM user_views WHERE TotalViews > 0
),
user_proportions AS (
    SELECT 
        uv.UserId,
        CASE WHEN tv.GrandTotal > 0 THEN uv.TotalViews * 1.0 / tv.GrandTotal ELSE 0 END AS Proportion
    FROM user_views uv
    CROSS JOIN total_views tv
)
SELECT 
    up.UserId,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY up.Proportion DESC) AS Rank
FROM user_proportions up;

user_page_views AS (
